body.message:
Good Morning Parva,

Hope you are doing well.

We would like to inform you that we can offer you the same rate for this unit for the next 3 months only.

If you wish to extend after that, we will still be happy to assist you; however, the rate may be subject to change depending on market conditions.

Please note that the rate is inclusive of VAT, taxes, and service fees. Additionally, a deposit of AED 3,000 is applicable.
